messages:
jules_sales: Hi team — matt from AcmePay asked for an "ISMS applicability statement" for the POC. They want: (a) short mapping of Annex A controls applicable to hosted POC, (b) named subprocessors and whether they process PII, and (c) confirmation about deletion/retention and backups. Can we put together something light they can hand to procurement?

sam_security: Quick clarifier — do they need a formal Letter of Applicability (LoA) or just a one-page applicability matrix + evidence links?

matt_cust: One page matrix + links. Procurement wants something concise, not the full LoA.

rita_se: For hosted POC we usually claim platform controls for Annex A sections: A.6, A.9, A.10, A.12, A.13, A.14 as "Redwood-managed". App-level auth and customer user lifecycle remain customer.

sam_security: Agreed. I'll produce a control ownership column with tags: "Redwood", "Customer", "Shared" and a 1-line rationale. Example: A.10 Cryptography -> Redwood (KMS-managed keys, TLS enforced). A.11 Physical -> Out-of-scope for hosted POC (we don't manage customer premises).

jules_sales: Subprocessor list — procurement insisted on named vendors. What can we disclose for a POC?

sam_security: We can disclose primary subprocessors used for hosted POC: AWS (EC2/S3), Cloudflare (CDN/edge), Postgres Cloud provider (DB hosting), Datadog (monitoring), and SendGrid (email). I'll run this by legal for naming restrictions but it's standard.

matt_cust: Which of those handle PII during the POC?

sam_security: Short answer: AWS and DB provider may store PII. Cloudflare may cache some request headers. SendGrid only if email flows are used. We'll annotate each subprocessor with "PII: yes/no" in the matrix.

rita_se: Retention / deletion: for hosted POC our standard offer is: application data and logs marked as POC will be securely deleted within 21 calendar days of POC end. Operational snapshots retained up to 10 days for recovery. We can provide a deletion verification script on request.

sam_security: Note: for Private/VPC POC, retention is under customer control; Redwood can provide tooling and a one-off verification run but cannot unilaterally delete customer-hosted data.

jules_sales: Procurement asked for a sample clause committing to deliver the matrix and evidence. Can we promise timelines?

sam_security: We can propose: "Redwood will deliver an ISMS applicability matrix and evidence pointer package within three (3) business days after execution of the NDA and POC order." Legal needs to finalise wording but that's our internal SLA for sales.

rita_se: Evidence pointers we'll include: ISMS Charter (redwood-isms-2025.pdf), Control Implementation Summary (ctrl-impl-summary.pdf), latest SOC/ISO attestation references (pdfs), infra hardening checklist, and a minimal export of the POC asset list (no secrets). We'll link to S3 package.

ops-bot: Evidence bundle ready: s3://redwood-evidence/pkgs/1799990123-poc-lite-bundle.zip (contains: ISMS_Charter_2025.pdf, ctrl-impl-summary.pdf, soc-attestation-ref.txt, infra-hardening.md, deletion-script.sh)

matt_cust: Can you also state whether backups are replicated offsite and for how long? Risk team will ask about geographic replication.

sam_security: Backups for hosted POC: snapshots are regionally replicated within the same cloud region only; retention 10 days; no geo-replication to other continents unless customer requests and we sign an addendum. We'll include that note under A.12.3 backups.

jules_sales: Any controls explicitly out-of-scope we should call out?

sam_security: Yes: A.11 (Physical security of customer premises), A.8.2 (Customer HR onboarding for their users), and any customer-side federation/SSO config are out-of-scope for Redwood in a hosted POC. We'll state these as "Customer responsibility" in the matrix.

rita_se: Pricing note: if they require a Private VPC POC for ISO boundary reasons, we charge a one-time private setup fee + minimum reserved capacity for the POC window. For 4-week POC we can discount setup by 50% but not waive reserved capacity. I'll attach a sample pricing snippet.

jules_sales: Action items + owners? I'll send to procurement once we have the draft.

rita_se: SE: produce the 1-page applicability matrix (control | owner | rationale | evidence pointer) + pricing snippet 12 hours.

sam_security: Security: finalize ownership tags, subprocessor PII flags, and suggested clause 36 48 hours.

ops-bot: Reminder scheduled: evidence bundle review meeting in 24h (link: https://meet.redwood/internal/iso-poc-review)

matt_cust: Thanks all. If you can get the matrix and links by Friday EOD that works for procurement.

jules_sales: Will do. Sending NDA now. :white_check_mark:
